Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.storedGuest: Without an account: a random profile ID in a cookie and activity on the site: answers, opened hints and solutions, tests, saved tasks and reports of errors in tasks. No name or email.
Privacy.storedAccount: With an account, in addition: name, email and picture from the Google account, sign-in tokens, the IP address and browser of each session, and the place on the site where the first sign-in started.
Privacy.storedErrors: When the site fails: the error description, page address, browser and device type, without the IP address or account data.
Privacy.purpose: To run the site: keeping progress, statistics, tests and sign-in. The legal basis is performance of a contract (Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection, Article 12(1)(2)). Session security, fixing errors and improving the site rely on legitimate interest (Article 12(1)(6)). Data is not used for advertising and is not sold.
Privacy.recipients: Google (sign-in), Cloudflare (site network), Neon (database, Germany), Sentry (errors, Germany) and the site server in Germany. Google and Cloudflare also process data in the US under standard contractual clauses.
Privacy.retention: Account and progress until the account is deleted. Sessions at most 30 days after last use. Profiles without an account 400 days after the last activity, empty profiles 30 days. Site errors at most 90 days. Reports of errors in tasks remain after the account is deleted, unlinked from the user.
Privacy.cookies: Only to run the site: the profile without an account, sign-in and the chosen language. An unfinished test is also kept in the browser. No advertising or analytics cookies are used.
Privacy.rights: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability and objection. The account and all progress are deleted on this page; other requests go to <mail>{email}</mail>. Complaints can be lodged with the Serbian Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection (<poverenik>poverenik.rs</poverenik>).
Privacy.minors: An account may be opened by a person aged 15 or older, and by a younger person with a parent's or guardian's consent.
Privacy.changes: The current version is on this page. If a translation differs, the Serbian text applies.
Privacy.signedOut: If you have an account, sign in to delete it.
Privacy.confirm: Your account, history and stats will be gone for good. This can't be undone.
Privacy.stale: For safety, sign in with Google again first, then delete your account.
Privacy.deleted: Your account and progress are deleted.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.service: Do indeksa (doindeksa.rs) is a free website for preparing for the university entrance exam in mathematics. It is not the official website of the Faculty of Technical Sciences and is not affiliated with any faculty.
Terms.results: The site checks only the final answer. Points and estimates are for practice, are not an official result and do not predict the entrance exam result. Do indeksa does not guarantee admission.
Terms.account: The site can be used without an account or with an account through Google. An account may be opened by a person aged 15 or older, and by a younger person with a parent's or guardian's consent. The account is deleted on the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy> page.
Terms.content: Solutions and tasks prepared by Do indeksa are published under the <cc>CC BY-NC-SA 4.0</cc> license, and the source code under the <mit>MIT</mit> license. Tasks from past entrance exams are given with their source.
Terms.rules: It is not allowed to disrupt the site, load it with automated requests or access other people's accounts.
Terms.liability: The site is provided free of charge, as is. The content may contain errors, and the site may be temporarily unavailable. To the extent permitted by law, Do indeksa is not liable for damage arising from use of the site.
Terms.changes: These terms may change; the current version is on this page. Serbian law applies. If a translation differs, the Serbian text applies. Contact: <mail>{email}</mail>.
